observed_behavior: WCAG SC 1.4.11 requires 3:1 contrast for qualifying visual information needed to identify interface components and relevant states, and for graphical objects needed to understand content, with exceptions.
context: W03 visual hierarchy/composition controlled acquisition; exact cited source scope only
limitations: Does not mean every decorative card stroke or divider must have 3:1 contrast.
notes: SOURCE INSPECTED only; no recommendation, runtime test or conformance determination
